scope: Scientific scope repairs, a reject-only review stage and bounded per-goal progress assessment; no new all-file parsing or universal resolution claim

scientific_review.method: Check explicitly cited excerpts against rendered complete original pages. Record scoped core support separately from machine scores, reviewer opinions and project acceptance.

checks: The analytical object is the optimal policy, not a closed-form fit of network parameters; optimization and policy extraction remain distinct.
Avoiding sampling retains language-model generation and the fine-tuning stage. This is not a claim that preference-data preparation or the whole pipeline is sampling-free.
The negative-control answer assigns the HH temperature and summarization temperature to their own tasks, as shown on DPO physical pages 24 and 25.
The seed case withholds a seed claim for the selected evidence; this is not a global assertion that the paper never reports a seed.
comparison.failure: The comparison editor returned malformed JSON. The service withheld the missing comparison and explicitly retained an incomplete answer; it did not silently retry.

checks: Frozen base weights and trainable low-rank adapters are supported by each original.
QLoRA distinguishes four-bit storage from dequantized BFloat16 computation.
NF4 is qualified by normally distributed weights, not universal quantization superiority.
Double quantization concerns quantization constants and memory overhead.
Paged optimizers transfer optimizer states between GPU and CPU to manage memory spikes; an explicit Chinese transfer action is no longer treated as missing.

review.initial_issue: A published restricted-attention claim reversed the maximum-path-length direction. The original response is preserved; the deterministic guard now withholds that saved error.
checks: The preference-learning contrast preserves the optimal-policy object and fine-tuning sampling scope.
The adapter contrast preserves frozen base weights and quantized-base gradient flow.
The Layer Normalization discussion preserves preliminary experiments and the ConvNet limitation, rather than claiming universal superiority.
remaining_qualifier_warnings: Larger-model capacity and preliminary acceleration remain qualitative shorthand; they are not universal superiority claims or independently verified numerical comparisons.
The separate-context model reviewer is fallible and sometimes conservative. Its rejected attention contrast is not itself a ground-truth label.
Twenty papers in the evidence pool do not mean twenty independently validated summaries or stable generation over repeated runs.

cases.reason: The selected ViT abstract supports an image-classification application, not every input/output modality, local-attention plan or less-sequential generation goal.

The selected all-linear-layer observation is partial evidence for a compound plan also mentioning LayerNorm and biases. The selected excerpt alone does not establish those other components or their absence from the entire paper.
A later reasoning abstract is not evidence of measured optimizer paging slowdowns.

future_progress.boundary: Goal coverage is lexical and intentionally conservative. Literal evidence, later dates and model assessments do not prove worldwide resolution; human decisions remain separate.
